title: McDonald mocked in congressional hearings after the Michigan flap

tellings.quote: And a congressman like famously like mocked that he was into UFOs and stuff like that. And like apparently the entire like congressional hall like was laughing at him.

plain: After a 1966 wave of UFO sightings in Michigan, a scientist named James McDonald who took UFOs seriously was, it is said, mocked in a hearing of the US Congress, with a congressman making fun of his interest and the whole room laughing. A researcher who goes by RedPandaKoala tells it as a well-known episode, without naming a source, as an example of how hard it was to raise the subject in public.
